metadata.name: Dune Harbor
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A sun-bleached desert spaceport under a hot, hazy sky. Domed adobe huts line a dusty main street patrolled by hover speeders, narrow alleys wind between them past a market of stalls and awnings and moisture vaporators on the roofs. The cantina has a bar, booths and a band stage, a back room where the hostages are held and a smugglers' cellar below. Three sunken circular docking bays: dropships and haulers in Bay 3 and Bay 7, and a light freighter you can walk into up its ramp, with a cockpit tube and a gun turret on its roof. Speeders and hover bikes to take, dunes beyond the town and a crashed escape pod half buried in the sand.

do.text: Dune Harbor. Watch your back in the cantina, and mind the speeders on the main street.
